name: mage
description: Storyteller assistant for running persistent Mage: The Ascension 2nd Edition chronicles. Chronicle creation/loading, mage creation and advancement, Arete rolls and Paradox, the three-stage combat turn, Sphere lookups and session state. Rulebook values are read from the reader's own copy of the book through a byo-rulebook module and are never bundled. Provides the `mage` skill; invoke as /mage.
